description.value: Elk Lakes Cabin is a backcountry wilderness hut operated by the Alpine Club of Canada, situated in the Kootenays region of British Columbia near Elk Lakes Provincial Park. It offers mattresses and requires advance reservation, serving as a remote overnight refuge for mountain travellers. Touring cyclists venturing into this high-alpine area would find a staffed-organization-managed hut with basic sleeping infrastructure in a spectacular wilderness setting.
